capabilities: Render animated mechanism diagrams from mechanism code blocks
Configure six mechanism types with per-block options (speed, roughness, shimmer, trace, caption)
Play and pause drawings by click or keyboard with screen-reader labels
Set global defaults and pause-off-screen behavior in plugin settings
Respect the system reduced-motion setting by starting drawings paused
disambiguation: Not a freehand sketching or drawing tool; drawings are generated from fenced code blocks, not drawn by the user.
extras: The manifest carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Documentation covers usage, all options, accessibility, manual installation, and the test suites, but not troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show moving mechanical diagrams; users would otherwise embed static images or GIFs of linkages and gear trains.

relations.evidence: Strokes are drawn with rough.js (the same engine Excalidraw uses)

summary: Renders live, hand-drawn animations of 2D mechanisms (four-bar, slider-crank, gears, cam, pendulum, spring-mass) from mechanism code blocks.
